text: BigModel GLM Provider 把智谱 BigModel Coding Plan 注册为 DSH 的 zai 模型路由，并按服务端在线列表筛选 GLM 型号。插件维护 GLM-4.5、4.6、5 及 GLM-5.3 系列，其中 GLM-5.3 Flash 支持图片输入。它会在凭据更新时刷新目录，并为模型请求配置 Coding Plan 接口格式。适合希望在 DSH 使用智谱编程模型或图文模型的开发者。需要 BigModel 账号，并在 DSH 凭据服务设置 BIGMODEL_API_KEY。

BigModel GLM Provider 的功能「GLM 模型目录」：将维护的 GLM 模型描述与服务端在线返回的型号核对，筛选后供 DSH 的 zai 路由选择。插件挂载或凭据引用更新时触发刷新。
BigModel GLM Provider 的功能「独立 zai 路由」：注册 pi-ai 适配器并提供选定模型，供 DSH 将会话请求发送到配置的 BigModel Coding Plan 地址。
BigModel GLM Provider 的功能「GLM-5.3 系列描述」：提供 GLM-4.5、4.6、5 和 GLM-5.3 系列模型元数据，其中 GLM-5.3 Flash 标注文本及图片输入能力，供模型列表使用。
BigModel GLM Provider 的功能「凭据鉴权」：从 DSH 凭据服务解析配置引用的 API key，并用于模型接口请求；缺少凭据时提供明确的 LLM 错误。
BigModel GLM Provider 使用前须知：模型目录刷新和模型请求均访问 open.bigmodel.cn；需先在 DSH 凭据服务配置 BIGMODEL_API_KEY。（见 src/index.ts:26,275-304）

Allows connecting to the **Zhipu AI BigModel / GLM** Coding Plan as an LLM Provider, enabling [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) to utilize the dedicated Coding Plan route and unlocking the verified **1M-token context models `glm-5.3` and the natively multimodal `glm-5.3-flash`** (along with `glm-4.5`, `glm-4.6`, and `glm-5`).
section: DSH Plugin: LLM Provider - BigModel GLM

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · Target Audience and Use Cases：Designed for developers with a Zhipu GLM Coding Plan membership or BigModel account who need to analyze large codebases, process long documents, or perform intensive code generation.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · Key Features：- **Unlocks 1M Context Window**: Directly select `glm-5.3` in the model selector, featuring a 1,000,000-token context limit and 128K max output capacity.
- **Native Multimodal Route**: `glm-5.3-flash` accepts image attachments beside text at the same 1,000,000-token context and 128K max output capacity.
- **Tailored for Coding Plan**: Connects to Zhipu AI's developer-focused Coding PaaS endpoint (`https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/models`).
- **Live Reconciled with Verified Exceptions**: Combines live endpoint discovery with verified support for `glm-5.3` that survives an endpoint that stops listing it.
- **Independent Provider Route**: The plugin registers its own `zai` adapter. It reuses the exported `PiAiAdapter` only for message and stream conversion, without depending on `llm-pi-ai` provider configuration or catalog seams.
- **Secure Credential Isolation**: The plugin resolves `BIGMODEL_API_KEY` through the Harness credential service for each request and never places the key in Cordis configuration or logs.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · Installation and Quick Start：Install a reviewed revision into a DeepSeek Harness profile. The repository includes a `dsh.bundle` patch and prebuilt runtime artifacts so no local build steps are required:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:OpenSaozi/dsh-bigmodel-catalog#<commit-sha>
```

The installed bundle contributes the following Cordis configuration:

```yaml
- id: model-catalog-bigmodel
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: BIGMODEL_API_KEY

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · Installation and Quick Start：The plugin owns the complete `zai` route: catalog, live filtering, credential resolution, and adapter registration all live in this package. Deployments may override `baseURL` for another Coding Plan endpoint and `apiKeyEnv` for another credential reference.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · What the model sees：No package-owned text. The plugin controls which BigModel descriptor, such as `glm-5.3`, can be selected; the exported `PiAiAdapter` owns request conversion.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · Token effect：No direct token effect. Tokenization and context use remain properties of the selected model and pi-ai's z.ai-compatible request implementation.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-model-catalog-bigmodel README · KV Cache effect：No direct effect. Selecting a different model may change provider-side cache eligibility, but this plugin adds no request content.
